Oratomic is building fault-tolerant neutral atom quantum computers. The Embedded Hardware & Software Engineer designs, builds, and operates quantum computers, focusing on low-level hardware and software for control and interfacing, including FPGAs, firmware, scientific cameras, and high-speed data acquisition.
Research

Responsibilities
Designing, building, and operating fault-tolerant neutral atom quantum computers
You will work in a tight-knit team, working across hardware (electronics, FPGAs, scientific cameras, computer hardware), software, processor design, and whatever else is required to build the working quantum computer
This role will focus on the low-level hardware and software needed to control and interface with the quantum computer, from FPGAs and firmware to scientific cameras and high-speed data acquisition, integrated within the quantum hardware team
